free_tier.stated: 10-30% of ALCF/OLCF/NERSC resources each year, with associated project storage (e.g. OLCF 200 TB archive, 50 TB work).

chaining: Larger per-project storage than most grants, but gated behind a DOE-relevant compute case.
limits_note: Requires 'Funded researchers affiliated with a university, lab, agency, or industry' AND a named DOE program manager/sponsor - 'you need to provide the name and email of your program manager/project sponsor... projects that do not have input from the sponsor program will not be competitive'. One-year allocation, renewable up to 3 with annual renewal. Proposals without a recognised funding source are rejected without review.
reliability_note: Effectively closed to an unaffiliated individual: two independent institutional gates (employer + DOE sponsor).
